summary: Frontend-only cPanel readiness audit: HEAD equals upstream 7db949f0395550338955c90a0d636bc19cc79bdf. Static pytest checks 10/10 passed; all 1,652 local CSS/JS/media references across TR/EN HTML exist and none use root-absolute /css, /js or /media paths. Six requested pages rendered at desktop/mobile; all 14 browser scenarios passed after one animation-wait correction and one rate-limit retry.

integration_issues.flow: Public preview under repeated page loads
integration_issues.issue: Transient HTTP 429 affected /en/index.html and nine media/script requests; a Cloudflare challenge generated CSP console messages and a challenge-service 401. English desktop retry passed. Initial run had zero console/page/HTTP errors. Not attributable to upstream HTML changes; exact rate-limit rule unavailable.

action_items: Upload frontend CONTENTS directly to public_html, preserving the hidden .htaccess at public_html/.htaccess. No build/install required.

On actual Apache/cPanel, verify mod_rewrite and AllowOverride, directory index handling, root and root index.html redirects to /tr/, language extensionless URLs and ErrorDocument behavior. Source-level checks passed; production server unavailable.
Configure a real external enquiry endpoint before expecting form delivery; separately configure careers/report endpoints and optional Instagram backend if those features are required.
If preview 429s persist, inspect edge/WAF rate-limiting analytics and response headers; avoid treating challenge-page errors as application JavaScript regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: No blocking static deployment regression identified; frontend/package.json has no dependencies or build script. Existing serve script is preview-only, not required by cPanel.

Existing testability debt: homepage register inputs/submit, cookie controls and several content links lack data-testid. Existing styles.css (2919 lines) and script.js (754 lines) exceed the 700-line maintainability guideline.
Existing placeholder social/location links use href=#; they do not lead to real destinations. Not introduced by the index-content merge.
Shared enquiry validation/status text remains English even on TR pages; source-only observation, submission intentionally not tested.

external_dependencies.dependency: nova-forms.js POSTs to (window.NOVA_API_BASE || '') + /api/enquiries. Pure static cPanel does not supply this endpoint; submissions were not exercised.
careers.js APPLICATION_ENDPOINT is null; online delivery is explicitly unavailable until a backend is configured.
speak-up.js REPORT_ENDPOINT is null; online delivery is explicitly unavailable until a backend is configured.
contact.js GETs /api/instagram/latest; bundled static snapshot is retained when unavailable.

Journal reads public raw.githubusercontent.com TR/EN JSON feeds; Google Fonts is external. These remain static-host compatible but need client network access; feed failure scenarios not tested in this run.

success_rate.frontend: Static 10/10; browser 14/14 eventually, final batch 13/14 plus successful English desktop retry

flaky_tests.result: Failed once with preview HTTP 429/challenge, passed one targeted retry; no reproducible HTML regression.

seed_data_creation: None; no form submissions or database changes. No MOCKED APIs or integrations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview Chromium only: 1920x1080 and 390x844. All six requested paths returned usable HTML and matched language, logo loaded, horizontal overflow <=1px. Both homepage videos readyState4/videoWidth1600 desktop and960 mobile. Header menu open/close passed after650ms transition wait. Both language workflows: homepage menu -> portfolio -> logo home -> East West CTA -> opposite-language East West page passed. Mobile and desktop hero screenshots reviewed; no scoped visual defects observed. Apache behavior audited as source only. Initial close-click failures were testing timing (forced clicks skip actionability animation waits), not application defects. No application files changed.
rca of the issue: Preview batch intermittently returned HTTP429 including EN HTML, causing selector timeout and Cloudflare challenge-script CSP errors. Isolated EN retry rendered normally with working menu and media. The 429 source rule cannot be established without edge analytics/headers; source audit found no missing assets or content-change runtime exception. Actual cPanel delivery and external submission integrations remain unverified.
